text: Compiles C/C++ code to WebAssembly using clang/clang++ with WASI support, executable via the wasm command
quote: clang/clang++ compiles your C/C++ files to webAssembly with wasi included. Execute the resulting files using 'wasm command'.

text: Lets you install additional pure-Python packages with pip directly on the device
quote: Use 'pip install' to add more Python packages (if they are pure Python).

text: Includes a built-in Vim editor for editing files and running syntax checkers like vim-lsp or ALE
quote: a-Shell comes with Vim included. You can edit your files and even run syntax checkers using e.g. vim-lsp or ALE.

text: Supports multiple terminal windows, each with its own context, appearance, command history, and working directory
quote: Each window has its own context, appearance, command history and current directory. `newWindow` opens a new window, `exit` closes the current window.

text: Lets you customize terminal appearance (font, size, background/text/cursor color and shape) via a config command
quote: You can change the appearance of a-Shell using `config`. It lets you change the font, the font size, the background color, the text color and the cursor color and shape.

text: Lets you bookmark the current directory and jump back to saved bookmarks later
quote: You can also bookmark the current directory with `bookmark`. `showmarks` will list all the existing bookmarks, `jump mark` and `cd ~mark` will change the current directory to this specific bookmark.

text: Integrates with Apple Shortcuts so users can automate downloading, processing, and releasing files via shell commands
quote: a-Shell is compatible with Apple Shortcuts, giving users full control of the Shell. You can write complex Shortcuts to download, process and release files using a-Shell commands.

text: Can access and use directories from other apps' sandboxes on the device via pickFolder, including running Python or TeX there
quote: a-Shell uses iOS file sharing ability. You can open directories in other app sandbox with pickFolder and run TeX or Python there. You can send the result in a third app.

text: Provides a help command that lists all available commands and lets you search for a specific one
quote: For help, type `help` in the command line. `help -l` lists all the available commands. `help -l | grep command` will tell you if your favorite command is already installed.

text: Supports VoiceOver accessibility, reading commands, output, and screen content aloud
quote: If you enable VoiceOver in Settings, a-Shell will work with VoiceOver: reading commands as you type them, reading the result, letting you read the screen with your finger...

text: Includes multiple built-in programming languages (Lua, Python, JavaScript, C, C++) that can be edited and run inside the app
quote: a-Shell comes with several programming languages: Lua, Python, JavaScript, C and C++. Edit your programs and run them inside the app.
